EFFECT_maxMonthlyComments: Until this resets, nobody on your site can post a new comment or reply, including you and your moderators. Reading existing comments, voting, and page loads still work.
EFFECT_maxMonthlyPageLoads: Until this resets, the comment widget does not load on your pages and visitors see a limit notice instead of comments.
EFFECT_maxMonthlyAPICredits: Until this resets, requests to the FastComments API with your API key are declined. The comment widget on your site keeps working.
EFFECT_maxMonthlySmallWidgetsCredits: Until this resets, small widgets such as comment counts and recent comments stop loading. The main comment widget keeps working.
EFFECT_maxSSOUsers: Until this changes, new users cannot sign in through SSO. Users who already have an account can keep signing in.
EFFECT_DEFAULT: Requests over this limit are declined until the limit changes.
EFFECT_WARNING_maxMonthlyComments: Once the limit is reached, nobody on your site will be able to post a new comment or reply, including you and your moderators, until it resets or you move to a bigger plan.
EFFECT_WARNING_maxMonthlyPageLoads: Once the limit is reached, the comment widget will stop loading on your pages until it resets or you move to a bigger plan.
EFFECT_WARNING_maxMonthlyAPICredits: Once the limit is reached, requests to the FastComments API with your API key will be declined until it resets or you move to a bigger plan.
EFFECT_WARNING_maxMonthlySmallWidgetsCre: Once the limit is reached, small widgets such as comment counts and recent comments will stop loading until it resets or you move to a bigger plan.
EFFECT_WARNING_maxSSOUsers: Once the limit is reached, new users will not be able to sign in through SSO until you move to a bigger plan.
EFFECT_WARNING_DEFAULT: Once the limit is reached, requests over it will be declined.
EXPLANATION_maxMonthlyComments: This counts every comment posted in the current calendar month, including comments that were deleted afterwards, which is why it can be higher than the comment count on your analytics page.
